analysis.reasonEn: After a sharp -11.4% decline over the last 5 trading days, attempts to rebound were met with RSI holding at 46.6 in neutral territory and MACD histogram worsening from 0.9191 to -0.7357, indicating continued bearish convergence. A Lower High pattern formed with the 5-day high ($357.13) below the 5-day low ($340.56). ADX at 16.3 suggests a non-trending environment with potential for shock-like volatility.
